title: Representation Engineering for Large-Language Models: Survey and Research Challenges
measurement_description: The paper is a comprehensive survey on Representation Engineering (RepE) for Large Language Models. It does not contain primary measurements or evaluations of faith or religion. It only briefly mentions religion in the context of probing LLMs for societal biases, noting that aligned models often outright refuse to engage with religion-related prompts.
findings: The paper does not focus on religion. Its only finding related to religion, cited from other literature, is that despite Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), models retain certain biases and may outright refuse to engage with race- and religion-related prompts.
